description: This file defines the UploadedFile class implementing the PSR-7 UploadedFileInterface, handling uploaded file data, validation, and file management.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: A class representing an uploaded file, providing methods for validation, moving, and retrieving stream data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new UploadedFile object, initializing properties based on provided stream/file, size, error, filename, and media type.

methods.name: validateActive
methods.description: Validates that the uploaded file has not been moved and has no upload errors.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream interface for the uploaded file, opening the file if necessary.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a new location specified by targetPath.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the client-supplied filename if available.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the client-supplied media type if available.
